title: BAFU 2026 v1 elementary flows → EF 3.1 characterization flow keys
description: Four biosphere packages applied in file order: each later package was built over what the earlier ones leave unmapped, and the validator guarantees they never conflict on the same source key. coverage.json is a non-normative pair-level sidecar with one row per BAFU flow, naming which package covers it or why none does.

packages.title: hand-reviewed reference bridge
packages.description: Reference package: BAFU-2026 v1 flows de-bridged from the carbonminds BAFU correspondence by characterization-factor identity, so every target is the EF 3.1 flow carrying the identical factor vector (no intermediate database identifier survives in the output), plus Eaternity's reviewed contributions landed in PRs #5, #6 and #10 (soil pairs, class-level land pairs, sub-compartment retargets). Source codes are UUIDv5 over name|category|subcategory|unit (sentier-importers sources/bafu/ecospold.flow_id); payload version 0.5.0. Radionuclide targets are kBq with a Bq source factor of 0.001 (issue #8).

packages.title: inferred via Eaternity's biosphere3 pair family
packages.description: Built over what biosphere-1-curated leaves unmapped: by construction this payload only holds flows biosphere-1-curated lacks. Derived by sentier-importers (sources/eaternity) from the ecoinvent-biosphere3__eaternity-bafu-ext bridge: each Eaternity target is placed at BAFU sub-compartment level through the biosphere3 sub-compartment retained on the ecoinvent-biosphere3__eaternity-bafu-ext bridge's entry (strict, never a fallback), and its biosphere3 partner is resolved to the EF flow carrying the identical characterization-factor vector in the same compartment (the de-bridging argument of biosphere-1-curated). Entries carry a comment only as a caveat: a superset twin (the EF flow is characterised in more impact categories) or a twin outside the matching EF sub-compartment. inference_review.json is a non-normative sidecar listing every withheld pair with its reason (Eaternity targets outside the BAFU-2026 v1 universe, biosphere3 partners without an EF 3.1 factor, no CF-compatible EF flow, superset candidates that disagree). Regenerate: python -m sentier_importers run eaternity-inferred-bafu-ef-biosphere (and eaternity-inferred-bafu-ef-review) --deliver-local ~/dds/sentier-mappings, with a fresh --cache-dir.

packages.title: public name/synonym/CAS/land/alias matching
packages.description: Built over what biosphere-1-curated and biosphere-2-inferred leave unmapped; holds only flows neither maps. Generated by sentier-importers (sources/bafu/mappings_biosphere_matched, package matching/) from public inputs only: BAFU flow names, EF synonyms (sentier-vocab alt_labels), CAS numbers, qualifier spellings, a land-use class rule, an ecoinvent-v2 ore-composite rule (leading element) and a curated alias table, matched against the EF 3.1 flows that carry a factor in sentier-methods. Tier order: name, land-use class, ore composite, synonym, qualifier, carbon oxide, ion, alias, the same tiers on the region-stripped name, then CAS. Placement is strict on sub-compartment (whole EF context leaf, same compartment) with two explicit, commented fallbacks: the EF unspecified context, and, for BAFU resource sub-compartments that carry no information (unspecified, land, biotic; in ground for water), the sole EF resource branch holding the substance. Target units are the EF reference units inferred from method membership (kilogram; kBq for radionuclides; cubic meter for water; megajoule for fossil energy resources; m2 or m2*a for land); a conversion_factor appears only for fixed same-substance factors (Bq→kBq, water kg→m3) and for the ecoinvent v2 net calorific values of six fossil/nuclear resource flows (hard coal 19.1, brown coal 9.9, crude oil 45.8, peat 9.9 MJ/kg; natural gas 38.3 MJ/Nm3; uranium 560000 MJ/kg; coal-mine off-gas approximated as natural gas at 38.3 MJ/m3), each commented; every other dimension cross is withheld. Decisions of 2026-09-13, all commented: fossil water → Ground Water; Nitrogen to water → Nitrogen, Total (excluding N2); ion-form source names (Arsenic, ion; Calcium II; Copper ion) → the EF element flow unless a CAS-verified species flow exists; unqualified Carbon dioxide / Carbon monoxide emitted to air → the EF (fossil) flows; Carbon dioxide, in air uptake → carbon dioxide (biogenic). Regionalised water and land names (Water, KR) carry the ISO code as target.location. Comments are caveats only. coverage.json (non-normative) has one row for every bafu-2026-v1 flow: mapped (package biosphere-1-curated, biosphere-2-inferred, biosphere-3-matched or biosphere-4-nomenclature, tier, placement) or unmapped with a reason. Regenerate with a fresh --cache-dir: python -m sentier_importers run bafu-ef-biosphere-matched --deliver-local ~/dds/sentier-mappings, then bafu-ef-biosphere-nomenclature, then bafu-ef-coverage.

packages.title: EF flows without a characterization factor (nomenclature alignment)
packages.description: Built over what biosphere-1-curated, biosphere-2-inferred and biosphere-3-matched leave unmapped; holds only flows none of them maps. Every target is an EF 3.1 elementary flow that exists in the EF nomenclature (sentier-vocab) but carries no characterization factor in any of the 25 EF 3.1 methods (sentier-methods), so the impact contribution of every entry is zero by construction; the bridge aligns names, not scores. Generated by sentier-importers (sources/bafu/mappings_biosphere_nomenclature) with the same matching as biosphere-3-matched on the EF index that includes uncharacterised flows. Because the EF vocab carries no context path for those flows, their sub-compartment is inferred from the Brightway context code sentier-vocab stores on every EF row (matching/bw_context.py, a crosswalk derived from the factor-bearing flows on 2026-09-13); entries whose code is ambiguous say so in their comment, and the six converted-energy resource flows (geothermal, solar, wind, hydropower, biomass energy) carry no target context at all because EF's context is not recoverable from the source context code (decision 2026-09-13). Two further relaxations, this package only and each commented: a flow whose EF namesakes all lack a factor is placed on the unspecified leaf of its compartment, or on its sole EF leaf, when its own sub-compartment does not exist in EF (nomenclature_placement, 13 entries); and BAFU's standing-wood and unspecified-water resources are aliased onto EF's factorless Wood and Water. Target units follow the EF convention for the source unit's dimension (kilogram, kBq, cubic meter, megajoule, m2, m2*a) with a conversion_factor whenever the source differs (Bq 0.001, kWh 3.6, water kg to cubic meter 0.001), so an EF flow fed by several BAFU unit twins receives one unit (fixed 2026-09-14 after a consumer found 91 flows fed by both Bq and kBq sources at factor 1); a source whose dimension cannot reach the target's counting unit is withheld rather than converted by an invented constant (standing wood in m3 onto EF Wood, counted by mass: unit_mismatch). Every entry's comment starts with 'uncharacterised in EF 3.1: no factor in any method'. Decision Laurenz 2026-09-13. Regenerate after biosphere-3-matched, with a fresh --cache-dir: python -m sentier_importers run bafu-ef-biosphere-nomenclature --deliver-local ~/dds/sentier-mappings. Round 5 (decision Laurenz 2026-09-14, "for the ones with names we map, else nothing"): a flow the pipeline cannot match at all whose exact name EF carries only in another compartment, every such namesake factorless, is aligned onto that namesake with no target context (placement name_only, 26 entries: Basalt, Bauxite, Carbon, Cinnabar, Clay, Colemanite, Diatomite, Dolomite, Feldspar, Fluorspar, Granite, Gravel, Kaolinite, Kieserite, Magnesite, Olivine, Perlite, Pyrite, Sand, Shale, Soil, Vermiculite); names whose namesake carries a factor anywhere (the salts, Talc, Uranium) are never aligned this way.
